actions.action: Check ivy stem at soil level for firmness or rot
Finger-test ivy soil moisture an inch down
Lightly water ivy only when top inch is dry
Place ivy in bright indirect light away from cold drafts
Loosely cover cutting with a clear bag or cup with air holes
Remove cover if condensation builds up
Check that the blue pot has a drainage hole
If it stays wet or doesn't perk up in 2-3 weeks, repot into smaller pot with drainage
If stem blackens at base, cut healthy section above rot and root in water
Water Christmas cactus only after top inch of soil dries
Empty water from Christmas cactus saucer
